en.title: Full Pattern Matching with Exactly One Star
en.description:
You are given n pairs of text and pattern. Each pattern contains exactly one *, which can be replaced by zero or more lowercase letters; no other character can be modified. Determine whether each pattern can become the entire corresponding text, and output YES or NO in order. The implementation does not use a built-in regex library.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines each containing text pat, separated by a space. 1≤n≤10, 1≤length of each text and pattern≤100000; texts are lowercase only, and patterns are lowercase apart from the single *.
en.output: Output YES or NO on each line, in input order.
en.explanation: The results are NO/YES, NO/YES and YES/YES. ab*bc needs at least 4 characters; the prefix and the suffix cannot share the same b.
hints: Split the pattern into the prefix before the star and the suffix after it; the text must be long enough to hold both parts, and its beginning and end must equal them respectively.
